term: one rigidly necessary being without incoming existential support
definition: At w₀ there is a concrete individual b that actually exists, exists at every world accessible from w₀, and has no direct existential-support edge from an existing candidate at any world in the admitted world carrier. b has the same identity across these modal alternatives. Uniqueness, intrinsic adequate explanation, simplicity, powers, and God are not included.
note: Analyst's source-free target of #495, narrower than a full theory of aseity. It deliberately separates modality and support from generic causes.
